reason.instructions: The change author declined reviewer_comment. What reason does author_reply give?

criteria.already_handled: The case is already handled, guarded or impossible because of code elsewhere (an earlier check, a caller, an invariant)
criteria.intentional: The behaviour is deliberate or by design
criteria.out_of_scope: The issue predates the change or belongs in another change
criteria.not_worth_it: The fix costs more than it is worth: too much code, too little benefit, unnecessary defensiveness
criteria.wrong_claim: The comment misreads the code, an API, a specification or a platform
criteria.preference: A matter of taste or consistency the author does not share
criteria.other: Some other reason, or none given
